embeds.title: BLHA AWARDS NIGHT
embeds.description: Season `[YEAR]` ballots are open in **🗳️│league-voting**. Owners choose the winners.

fields.name: THE AWARDS
fields.value: **GM of the Year** • **Trade of the Year** • **Waiver Steal of the Year** • **Comeback Franchise** • **Bust of the Year** (all in good fun)

fields.name: HOW TO VOTE
fields.value: Press **Fill out my ballot** on the League Bot's post in **🗳️│league-voting**: a 1st, 2nd and 3rd choice for each award, worth 5, 3 and 1 points. One ballot per franchise, cast by the Franchise Owner. Change it any time until **`[TIMESTAMP]`**.

fields.name: NO SELF-VOTES
fields.value: Your own franchise, your own pickups and trades you were part of aren't on your ballot. Bust of the Year is the exception.

fields.name: RESULTS
fields.value: Most points wins; a tie goes to the most first-place votes, then the award is shared. Winners are announced in **🏆│hall-of-champions** and kept in the league records.

fields.name: JUST FOR FUN
fields.value: Awards carry no money and change nothing in the standings or the draft.

embeds.title: NEW TRADITION? THE WOODEN SPOON
embeds.description: A just-for-fun tradition for the last-place team. Owners decide whether we do it.

fields.name: THE IDEA
fields.value: The franchise that finishes last in the regular season holds the **Wooden Spoon** role for the Offseason and writes a short preview of the next Season, posted before Week 1.

fields.name: WHAT IT ISN'T
fields.value: No money and no rule change. Draft order still comes from Potential Points (14.5), so the Spoon can't be chased.

fields.name: HAVE YOUR SAY
fields.value: React 👍🏻 or 👎🏻 by **`[TIMESTAMP]`**, or reply in **💬│gm-lounge**. It starts only if owners want it.

embeds.title: THE WOODEN SPOON
embeds.description: **`[FRANCHISE]`** finishes last in Season `[YEAR]` and takes home the Spoon.

fields.name: THE TRADITION
fields.value: `[OWNER]` holds the Wooden Spoon role for the Offseason and writes the Season `[NEXT YEAR]` preview, posted before Week 1.

fields.name: NO PENALTY
fields.value: Draft order is unaffected: it comes from Potential Points (14.5).

embeds.title: MEET THE BLHA LEAGUE BOT
embeds.description: League tools, right in Discord. Every command reads Fantrax and the Constitution; nothing here changes Fantrax.

fields.name: YOUR TEAM
fields.value: `/myteam` shows your roster counts, picks you own, how far your dues are paid and this Week's matchup. Only you see it.

fields.name: RULES
fields.value: `/rule 12.4` or `/rule prepayment` shows the Constitution's text. `/deadlines` lists the next dates.

fields.name: PLAYERS AND TRADES
fields.value: `/minor` checks a player's minors eligibility. `/tradecheck` checks a trade against the rules (picks, prepayment, roster limits, the deadline). It never grades a trade.

fields.name: PICK'EM
fields.value: Each Week the bot posts the matchups in **🏒│game-day**. Make your picks before the Week starts; a season leaderboard keeps score.

fields.name: VOTING
fields.value: Proposals and official votes run through the bot in **🗳️│league-voting**, one vote per franchise (Article XX).
